name: Home Guests
lines: Knock, and whoever lives here gets a message on their phone and can let you in.
Sign in, and a home of your own opens to you.
Let folks into your home, and keep your kitchen stocked.
The Keeper has paused kitchens for now.
Go into your home (or one you are a guest at) to open its kitchen. Groceries to take home are sold at the Bakery, the Greengrocer's, the Butcher's, the Dairy, the General Store and the Brewhouse.
You have no home yet. Buy or rent one at the Land Office; then you can let folks in.
Your guests may go into every home you live in.
The Keeper has paused guests for now.
Let anyone in for a while: a party, a viewing, a housewarming.
Let folks into your home, and stock your kitchen
What you have bought and carry with you
The kitchen is empty. Buy groceries at the Bakery, the Greengrocer's, the Butcher's, the Dairy, the General Store or the Brewhouse, bring them home and put them away.
Go into your home (or one you are a guest at) to put it away in the kitchen.
The kitchen · press E (or tap here) for the fridge, the cupboards and the stove
Into your shopping bag; put it away in your kitchen at home (Menu, then Guests and kitchen).
Groceries to take home are on the shelves soon.
